<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Failed to generate report</span></div>

## Why it happens

- A device, entity view or key the template uses was deleted or renamed.
- A script in the template has an error.
- The time window holds no data where the template requires it.

## Fix it

1. Open the report in **Reporting > Reports** and read its error.
2. Open the template in the builder and run **Generate** with the same time window to see the problem on screen.
3. Fix the data source or script, then generate again.

## Check that it worked

A new run ends with status **Completed**.
